integrity: Proof uses exact integer carry matrices and a standard finite-state ergodic theorem; finite checks corroborate but do not prove infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the threefold fair-digit additive convolution on the ternary adic integers; it establishes correlation dimension, not entropy dimension or arbitrary order. An earlier equivalent weighted-carry calculation may exist.
title: Threefold ternary Cantor convolution: full support, singularity, and exact collision dimension
